profile.headline: Software Engineer at GraphiumHealth
profile.summary:
Hi!
   I am a recent graduate of the University of Virginia with a B.S. in Computer Science. I have experience as a Software Engineer at CoStar Group and as a Software Engineering Intern at Fortitude Technologies LLC. My core technologies include C#, Java, Python, AWS S3, React JS, HTML/CSS, MySQL, and ASP.NET. 
   At CoStar Group, I designed and implemented an end-to-end message analytics system for BizBuySell, built a dynamic pricing engine API resulting in a > 99% reduction in effort, and migrated the entire pricing backend application flow from legacy ASP.NET Webforms to modern ASP.NET MVC. 
   At Fortitude Technologies LLC, I built an internal platform that matched open contracting positions with applicants based on predicted skill sets. I led the implementation of an email automation process using AWS Cloud Services. 
   Additionally, I am passionate about promoting diversity and inclusion in the tech industry and served as the Vice President of UVA - Women in Computing Sciences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed an end to end message analytics system to measure the effectiveness of BizBuySell’s broker recommendation engine for 3.5 million monthly active users. Implemented the database schema and asynchronous data processing pipeline that runs daily.
-Built a dynamic pricing engine API in C# that computed monthly pricing changes based on automated or manual sales offers. This represented >99% reduction in effort,  saving ~1200hrs/year in recurring manual work to inform clients of complex pricing changes.
-Migrated the entire pricing backend application flow from the legacy ASP .NET Webforms to the more modern ASP .NET MVC, providing greater flexibility and separation of concerns. This consolidated code for easier use and ability to incorporate the new pricing structure for new clients. Provided new API endpoints in C# to redirect and process user information. 
-Engineering productivity champion: Regularly showcased coding hygiene best practices for code reviews and testing to reduce technical debt.

positions.title: SWE Intern at Fortitude Technologies LLC
positions.description:
-Built an internal platform in the US government contracting space that matches open contracting positions with applicants based on predicted skill sets, improving the company’s hiring practices and ability to compete for talent by utilizing AWS Cloud Services
-Led the implementation of the email automation process with AWS Simple Email Service, Simple Queue Service, and Simple Notification Service
-Designed and completed prototype architecture featuring React JS (new), Python Lambdas, AWS Serverless Application Model, AWS API Gateway (new), and AWS Aurora RDS instance(MySQL)
-Participated in weekly sprints and daily standups
-Increased code coverage for the front-end and back-end
   --Web-app code coverage from 0% to 50%
   --Lambda code coverage from 55% to 83%

positions.title: JUMP URI Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Analyzed and compared heart motions of patients with heart disease to healthy heart disease using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to help improve medical image analysis within the research team
-Utilized Matlab and DENSEAnalysis Software to more easily understand the heart images.

Debs and Phils is a youth auxiliary organization for the Boise Philharmonic. As President, I organized members to specific doors to hand out programs or to hand out tickets. I also was in charge of the coat check leading up to the concert.
